physics-killer-04.goal: Analyze the underlying scientific principles and deduce the correct conclusion.
physics-killer-04.material: A lance mbeni balle na horizontal ti ndö ti mbeni falaise so ndö ti ni ayeke $20\,\mathrm{m}$, na ni asi na sese ti falaise na distance horizontale $30\,\mathrm{m}$ ti falaise. Na $g=10\,\mathrm{m/s^2}$ na résistance ti air ayeke pëpe, vitesse ti balle na lâ so ni asi na sese na $\tan\theta$ ti angle $\theta$ so direction ti vitesse asâra na plan horizontal na lâ so, a fa ni mbeni-mbeni na ordre ayeke nzoni wa?
physics-killer-04.thinking.0: Collision na sécurité, projection horizontale na gravité
physics-killer-04.s.s1.prompt: A lance mbeni balle na horizontal ti ndö ti mbeni falaise so ndö ti ni ayeke $20\,\mathrm{m}$, na ni asi na sese ti falaise na distance horizontale $30\,\mathrm{m}$ ti falaise. Na $g=10\,\mathrm{m/s^2}$ na résistance ti air ayeke pëpe, vitesse ti balle na lâ so ni asi na sese na $\tan\theta$ ti angle $\theta$ so direction ti vitesse asâra na plan horizontal na lâ so, a fa ni mbeni-mbeni na ordre ayeke nzoni wa?
physics-killer-04.s.s1.explain: Na direction verticale $20=\frac12\cdot10\cdot t^2\Rightarrow t=2\,\mathrm{s}$. Na direction horizontale $30=v_0t\Rightarrow v_0=15\,\mathrm{m/s}$. Kozo ti asi na sese $v_y=gt=20\,\mathrm{m/s}$. $v=\sqrt{15^2+20^2}=25\,\mathrm{m/s}$, $\tan\theta=\dfrac{v_y}{v_0}=\dfrac{20}{15}=\dfrac43$. Tongana a zi vitesse na $v_0+gt=35$, ayeke mauvaise réponse ①, tongana a sâra $\tan\theta$ na ndö-ndö, ayeke $\frac34$ (mauvaise réponse ②), tongana a sâra gï composante verticale $20\,\mathrm{m/s}$ tongana vitesse, ayeke mauvaise réponse ④.
physics-killer-04.s.s2.prompt: Which scenario demonstrates the correct real-world application of this principle?
physics-killer-04.s.s2.explain: The fundamental principles of this inquiry are widely implemented in modern technology.
